target.title: fix(provider-runtime): align transient network error codes across retry paths
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`operation-retry.ts` (provider API 调用重试) 和 `run-wait.ts` (gateway agent 等待重试) 各自维护了瞬时网络错误码的正则表达式，但覆盖范围不一致：

| 错误码 | operation-retry.ts | run-wait.ts |
|--------|:---:|:---:|
| ECONNRESET | ✓ | ✓ |
| ECONNREFUSED | ✓ | ✓ |
| ETIMEDOUT | ✓ | ✓ |
| EAI_AGAIN | ✓ | **✗** |
| EPIPE | **✗** | ✓ |
| EHOSTUNREACH | **✗** | ✓ |
| ENETUNREACH | **✗** | ✓ |
| ENOTFOUND | **✗** | ✗ |

当 provider API 调用遇到 `EHOSTUNREACH`/`ENETUNREACH`/`EPIPE` 时，provider 路径不重试直接失败，而 gateway 路径会重试。同一类瞬时网络错误在不同路径的处理不一致。

## Why This Change Was Made

最小化修复：两边各补缺失的瞬态错误码，同时有意保留 `ENOTFOUND` 只在 provider 路径的差异（gateway hostname 解析失败应是配置错误，重试无意义）。

## User Impact

- 修复前：provider API 调用遇到 `EPIPE`/`EHOSTUNREACH`/`ENETUNREACH` 时直接失败
- 修复后：这些连接层瞬时错误会被正确识别为可重试，用户不会遇到不必要的操作失败

## Evidence

- 4 files, +97/-3 lines
- 单元测试：`operation-retry.test.ts` +5 用例，`run-wait.test.ts` +5 用例，含 positive/negative/有意排除项
- 37 tests passed (8 + 29)
- autoreview clean (claude-sonnet-4-6, thinking=high): no accepted/actionable findings
